success.description: 1 You reach out with your magic and improve the form of the target item. It becomes stronger than steel and its durability improves. Attempts to break the item suffer a -1 penalty. The spell's effects last until the end of the episode.
As above, and the item becomes a superior example of its type.

boon.description: MM A numerical trait of the item, such as soak value or Pierce rating, improves by {Df} until the end of the episode. You may trigger this effect multiple times. Each time, it affects a new trait.

bane.description: The item suffers a -1 penalty. The spell's effects last until the end of the episode.

sigmarsComet.description: The item becomes truly unbreakable until the end of the act.
